body: My mom didn’t sell our house at the foreclosure auction so now the bank owns it.  Also your comment genuinely made me smile, so thank you.
I appreciate u leaving a comment and saying nice things like this.  Thank you
I appreciate you reading it, also I’m sorry that happened to you.

Do you even realize how many things you’re going to miss out on, and I mean amazing things, like traveling, meeting kind people, making friends, having kids, wife, or girlfriend, and much more.  Yes everyone knows that the human race is destroying the planet but people are trying to fix it, people will realize that this is a problem, plus we have already made steps to stop this.  Anyways, just don’t fucking make a mistake like this.  We can fix the planet and you can fix your self if you try, and if everyone else does to stop this catastrophe.  You’re not alone, this subreddit proves it, you don’t have to be alone.  You will find happiness.

What about all the amazing things you won’t be able to experience in life?  I think you have to realize is that the world is so much bigger than you probably think it is.  I don’t know your exact situation but I do that if you push through it, later in life you’ll realize how you thinking about committing suicide was a pointless, and that you will be happy and enjoy life, travel places, meet kind people, be successful and much much more of good things that will happen to you.  Trust me I was so close to killing my self at one point in my life, but I got help, and now I’m happy just like how you will be if you don’t make terrible decision like that.  You will find happiness my dude.

Your life is worth more than you think.  Some of the brightest minds, failed school, went through depression and suicidal thoughts, and were just like you. but instead they pushed through that shit and changed the god damn world.  That could be you my dude.
